description: A two-room flat with a galley kitchen, a bed and a woodblock floor lifting at the corners. A picture window opens onto a balcony just wide enough for a chair. From this high the Basin is the whole view. You can hear the stairs through the west wall. The bathroom is through a door at the back.

window.description: A bronze-framed picture window onto the balcony, and nothing above you but the roof. The Basin is all the view there is.
window.name: the balcony window

name: Kestrel Court, Unit 11A
